load_args_from_list: load a list of argument strings into the ArgParser using double-dash keys and values
load_args_from_file: load argument key-value pairs from a config file into the ArgParser ignoring comment lines
parse_string_value: parse a single string value for a given key with an optional default from the ArgParser
parse_int_value: parse a single integer value for a given key with an optional default from the ArgParser
parse_bool_value: parse a single boolean value for a given key with an optional default from the ArgParser
